Watcher Guardians are summonable allies during Confront the Elder Brain, using their great weapon mastery to protect the city against the Absolutist forces' incursion.
“
The City Watch will join you!
„
— Watcher Guardian's battle cry

Involvement

Act Three

During the initial battle for High Hall, a large force of infiltrated Absolutist cultists coming from the Upper City Sewers destroyed and routed the City Watch away from the keep, forcing what's left of the Watch to flee. Faced with severe casualties, what remains of the disposable City Watch forces available to retake High Hall are in the form of a small squad of Watcher Guardians under Constable Valeria's orders, and an incohesive group of panicked Watchmen attempting to escape the High Hall's courtyard.[1]

These Watcher Guardians can be summoned with the  Gather Your Allies variant,  The Watch if Valeria has been saved and is an ally present for the final battle. Summons a male half-orc, a female tiefling, and a female gold dwarf to fight at the party's side.

Combat

Watcher Guardians are potent melee fighters capable of taking a generous amount of heat thanks to their high Armour Class and HP pool, as well as dishing significant damage thanks to their  Great Weapon Master: All In passive.

Notes

  • Some members of this archetype may have slightly different passives, movement speed, weight, and size due to being members of different races.
  • These summonable Watcher Guardians have identical stats to the named Watchmen seen running away from the courtyard, those being  Gyordi,  Ebber,  Fry, and  Goodge.
    • However, these named Watchmen' armour resemble that of the  Breastplate +1 dyed in blue, brown, and black colours, rather than the armour specifically designed for The Watch that the Watcher Guardians and the Dead Watchmen wear.
  • There are several other Watcher Guardian dead bodies strewn throughout the courtyard of High Hall, some of them being dyed in inconsistent schemes of blue and yellow, and blue and red hues.
